title: ErrorMessage
description: Server -> client. A protocol-level fault: unparseable, unsupported, unauthenticated, or otherwise unhandleable. Never fatal to the connection on its own -- one bad message must not take a peer down. Expected refusals of well-formed requests use `connectRejected` instead.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Deliberately vague where precision would leak which deviceIds or codes exist; branch on `code`, never on this.
